method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Medical Registration Act 1997 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run mra-cases-discipline.l4 ; l4 run mra-cases-practice.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: SCOPED to practice and discipline as they reach a patient or a doctor. mra-practice.l4: ss 13 to 17 (who may practise, fees, medical certificates, unauthorised practice and the traditional-medicine defence), s 59F(3) as used, ss 62 to 65 (fraud, practising while suspended, titles), s 66 (ships' surgeons), s 66A (composition), s 67 (reporting an unfit colleague). mra-discipline.l4: ss 41 and 42 (six-year limit and public-interest override), s 59D (grounds and orders), ss 59E(6), 59F and 59G (timing and appeals). Not encoded: Part 2 (the Council), Part 4 (registers and registration routes), Parts 5 and 5A, Part 6, the committees, investigations, Health Committees and interim orders of Part 7, and Parts 8 and 9 beyond the sections listed.
